The Core-owned project, actor, rights, classification, deployment and budget witness is rechecked before dispatch, publication and persisted-success replay. Portable policy fields can restrict but never grant permission.

dependencyAndPromotionBoundary.current: Task inputs and result citations/output carry immutable revision/hash identities; routing history binds the exact task, policy and selected manifest. This slice records journal/catalog provenance and outbox facts, not domain-specific research-output promotion.
dependencyAndPromotionBoundary.downstreamObligation: A consuming research workflow must validate and obtain its required human disposition before promoting an output, register the actual artifact/model/intent dependencies with CAP-03, and use the existing staleness machinery when those identities change. A routing success or catalog refresh is not scholarly acceptance and does not silently regenerate a research artifact.
dependencyAndPromotionBoundary.qualificationLimit: The separate handoff seam may prove protected metadata dependency registration and precise staleness propagation with declared fixture hashes. It does not prove content bytes, live-model output promotion, provider-specific payload consent, arbitrary provider-version translation or a process restart.
